title: Evaluating open-source Large Language Models for automated fact-checking

bias_targets.methodology: Disaggregating evaluation metrics (Precision, Recall, F1 score) for positive (True) and negative (False) claims to identify whether the models exhibit a predisposition towards accepting or rejecting statements.

Comparing model fact-checking accuracy (F1 scores) on claims published before 2024 (likely within the training data) against claims published in 2024 (after the training cutoff date) to determine if outdated training data skews performance.
